findings.evidence: Lines 75–78 hard-code `. {u}` and `K : Type u`; `FiniteType/CommHopfAlgCat.lean:51` and `Smooth/CommHopfAlgCat.lean:39` instead define their object properties on `CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R` for `R : Type u`.
findings.fix: Give the property independent base, Hopf-algebra, and extension universes (using an appropriate common universe/ULift formulation), and specialize to the same-universe case only in the `hopfSpec` comparison that requires it.
findings.issue: The core coordinate property only accepts `H : CommHopfAlgCat.{u} k` and `K : Type u`, although tensor-product reducedness is not inherently same-universe; unlike the existing finite-type and smooth properties, it cannot describe Hopf algebras whose carrier universe differs from the base.

findings.evidence: Lines 91–97 prove reducedness using `H ⊗[k] k`; lines 101–109 prove `Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced k H`, while `Mathlib/RingTheory/Nilpotent/GeometricallyReduced.lean` defines `Algebra.isReduced_of_isGeometricallyReduced`.
findings.issue: `.isReduced` duplicates a special-case tensor-product argument before the stronger `.isGeometricallyReduced` result, even though Mathlib already derives reducedness from geometric reducedness over a field.

summary: The new coordinate property is unnecessarily same-universe, and its reducedness corollary is proved separately instead of derived from the stronger comparison.
